s1.desc: a bedroom with a big cream bed, a bedside table and a lamp, drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a duck-shaped bedpost and a bedside lamp behind the bed

beats.text: Polly snuggles against Pax with her head on his fin while he lies asleep on his back in bed
Polly sits up beside him with a sleepy smile, uncovering his fin, now drawn as fuzzy grey static
Pax opens his eyes and looks over at Polly as she gazes back at him

effects: numb fin drawn as grey static
spans.notes: the numb-fin gag: from about f24 Pax's fin is drawn as grey static noise (a local in-world effect, not the whole picture)
closer view of Pax in bed: Polly slides off to the right, his static-noise fin lies limp, he tries to lift it and panics; slow continuous drift, every edge doubled in compare 37/118, 60/72, 60/84

spans.view: with a duck-shaped bedpost and a bedside lamp behind the bed

beats.text: Pax lies propped up on the bed, staring with worried eyes at his limp fin, drawn as fuzzy grey static
Polly hurries in from the right and grabs Pax's numb fin as he turns to her with wide eyes
Polly tugs and shakes the numb fin with a worried face while Pax leans back, sweating
Polly raises her other flipper high over her head and brings it down to slap Pax's numb fin
Pax jolts upright with wide eyes as his fin turns into bright stripes of test-pattern colours
Pax stares ahead with wide eyes while Polly holds the striped fin and looks down at it
Pax tips his head back with his eyes squeezed shut while Polly keeps holding the striped fin, looking worried

effects: numb fin drawn as grey static
fin drawn as test-pattern colour bars
